links.outcome: Evidence recall across 15 query formulations on five RAG-LLM platforms
links.effect: Median formulation-level recall ranged from 7.2% to 42.2%; pooled platform recall ranged from 45.8% to 72.3%; single-query zero-retrieval probability 47% to 80% for the largest evidence category.
links.quote: Median formulation-level recall ranged from 7.2% to 42.2%, while pooled platform recall ranged from 45.8% to 72.3%.

unlisted_practices: Domain-specific evaluation of RAG-LLM evidence-search tools before use in clinical or research workflows
Using multiple query formulations or platforms to reduce evidence retrieval gaps

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of commercial RAG and LLM tools (Consensus, ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, etc.) for evidence retrieval in healthcare, benchmarking retrieval recall and blind spots across query formulations.
